bridgeNativeTransactionFilterPolicy.purpose: Only ordinary boot-class BinderProxy JNI: unmatched code directly calls registered original JNI in C; matched code retains original Java bridge callback, exception marshaling and policy. Runtime method IDs/spec offsets/module identity, no fixed addresses. Successfully published C gates and callbacks retained until script end; setter revert restores original behavior without freeing in-flight code. Private-clone JNI pointer is published through prebuilt native seqcst RMW under exclusive ART suspension, with full Java-setter restoration if publication fails. Writable CModule counters are extern Memory.alloc symbols retained with the gate, never module read-only data. CriticalNative is excluded by proved instance/reference JNI shape, not a version-dependent access flag alias. Original Frida implementation getter returns the installed NativeCallback; fallback ownership uses that captured replacement. Own CModule capability uses harmless counter/native scratch-publisher execution, not cloak-filtered Process range enumeration; original registered system JNI module/RX validation remains mandatory.

bridgeQuickCodePublicationPolicy.purpose: Prepare and flush complete quick-entry prologue bytes off-target before exclusive ART suspension; the paused patchCode callback only copies prepared bytes and finalizes I-cache synchronization. Restore uses the same publication protocol and retains retired trampoline owners/slices until script end. No live literal placeholder, JNI or writer generation during suspension; existing architecture/relocation choices remain. Before restoring, skip an identifiable later owner and retain trampolines. Commit errors attempt prepared rollback inside the same suspension. A failed shared bootstrap is sticky until target-process recreation, so partial success cannot be reported as complete. Also covers original ARM/ARM64 inlined OatQuickMethodHeader redirects and InlineHook restoration. Trampoline construction remains private/unpublished; semantic scan/relocation/register selection is unchanged.

bridgeSelectiveBatchPolicy.purpose: Opaque method IDs resolve before bounded Native-state exclusive batches.
